name: cabinet-open-simple
description: IXT-SUITES simple rung for the Doors & drawers cabinet-open interaction (CABINET-OPEN, v0.21.2.8). Waits out the async move-in furnishing, finds the default flat's cabinet-family item (the main-bedroom wardrobe), asserts supportsCabinetOpen, selects it, toggles the inspector's Open/Close control both ways with a screenshot each side, then asserts the cabinetOpen flag gate hides/shows the control.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: wait-boot-ready
steps.failMessage: Boot never reached bootPhase='ready' + sceneReady — the async move-in furnishing (bootstrap.ts's 'seed' step) may still be pending

steps.name: find-cabinet-item
steps.eval: (async () => { const { supportsCabinetOpen } = await import('/src/furniture/cabinetOpen.ts'); const { BUILTIN_CATALOG } = await import('/src/furniture/builtinCatalog.ts'); const s = window.__store.getState(); const hit = s.items.find((it) => supportsCabinetOpen(BUILTIN_CATALOG[it.defId])); if (!hit) throw new Error('No cabinet-family item found in the default move-in layout: ' + JSON.stringify(s.items.map((i) => i.defId))); window.__cabItemId = hit.id; window.__cabDefId = hit.defId; s.updateItemProps(hit.id, { doorStyle: 'hinged' }); return hit.id + ' / ' + hit.defId; })()

steps.name: verify-supports-cabinet-open
steps.eval: (async () => { const { supportsCabinetOpen } = await import('/src/furniture/cabinetOpen.ts'); const { BUILTIN_CATALOG } = await import('/src/furniture/builtinCatalog.ts'); const def = BUILTIN_CATALOG[window.__cabDefId]; if (!supportsCabinetOpen(def)) throw new Error('supportsCabinetOpen(def) is false for ' + window.__cabDefId); })()

steps.name: room-active
steps.failMessage: Room editor did not activate for mainBedroom

steps.name: frame-cabinet-front
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = window.__three; if (!t || !t.controls) throw new Error('__three.controls not exposed'); const s = window.__store.getState(); const it = s.items.find((i) => i.id === window.__cabItemId); const wx = it.position[0], wz = it.position[1]; t.controls.target.set(wx - 0.3, 1.0, wz); t.camera.position.set(wx - 1.4, 1.5, wz + 1.2); t.controls.update(); })()

steps.name: inspector-visible
steps.failMessage: Inspector panel did not mount after selecting the cabinet item

steps.name: verify-doors-section-present
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = document.querySelector('.panel.inspector')?.textContent || ''; if (!t.includes('Doors & drawers')) throw new Error('Doors & drawers section not found in inspector: ' + t.slice(0,200)); if (![...document.querySelectorAll('.panel.inspector button')].some((b) => b.textContent?.trim() === 'Open doors & drawers')) throw new Error('Open doors & drawers button not found'); })()

steps.name: toggle-open-via-inspector
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.panel.inspector button')].find((b) => b.textContent?.trim() === 'Open doors & drawers'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Open button not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: verify-open-true
steps.failMessage: props.open did not flip to 'yes' after clicking Open doors & drawers

steps.name: toggle-close-via-inspector
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.panel.inspector button')].find((b) => b.textContent?.trim() === 'Close doors & drawers'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Close button not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: verify-open-false
steps.failMessage: props.open did not flip to 'no' after clicking Close doors & drawers

steps.name: verify-control-absent
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = document.querySelector('.panel.inspector')?.textContent || ''; if (t.includes('Doors & drawers')) throw new Error('Doors & drawers section still present with cabinetOpen flag off: ' + t.slice(0,200)); })()

steps.name: verify-control-present-again
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = document.querySelector('.panel.inspector')?.textContent || ''; if (!t.includes('Doors & drawers')) throw new Error('Doors & drawers section did not come back with cabinetOpen flag re-enabled'); })()
